hints: NOT RECOMMENDED FOR NEW DESIGN – the manufacturer names the PAM8406 instead (data sheet p. 1).
With LC output filters, connect the speaker before power-on, otherwise the device is easily damaged (p. 7, note 1).
Without LC filters, a ferrite bead in each speaker line against EMI (p. 7 note 2, p. 9 Figure 2).
Supply above 6.0 V damages it – four fresh alkaline cells are over 6.0 V (p. 7, note 3).
High gain (24 dB): an input large enough to clip the output can damage the device (p. 7, note 4).
